reason: I lost a sale because I was slow to send the file, and with Maketia I still have to confirm each payment myself and send the link by hand. That is the same work as WhatsApp, plus a new SasPay account and an editor to learn, so I would not pay 9 900 FCFA a month for it.
objection: It doesn't fix my real problem, which is the delay in sending the file. Confirmation is manual, and I'm not comfortable opening a SasPay account and learning a new tool when my clients already pay me by mobile money on WhatsApp.
would_change_my_mind: Automatic confirmation that sends the file to the buyer the moment the mobile-money payment arrives, without me touching anything.
